author: feature-implementer
summary: Clamp owners listing page param below 1 to first page. GET /owners with page=0, -1, -99 now returns 200 with owners/ownersList instead of the error page. Fix: Math.max(page,1) at processFindForm entry. Added test processFindFormClampsPageBelowOneToFirstPage.

author: security-reviewer
approved_aspects: page param is bound as primitive int, so Spring rejects non-numeric and out-of-int-range input with a 400 before the handler; the clamp only needs to cover the numeric lower bound
Math.max(page,1) guarantees page-1 >= 0 in PageRequest.of, closing the negative/zero offset case with no underflow or overflow (page always >= 1)
page flows only into a parameterized Spring Data JPA PageRequest offset/limit; no string concatenation, so no SQL/JPQL injection is introduced
no new attack surface: no file I/O, deserialization, reflection, or output rendering changed; lastName handling is untouched and Thymeleaf auto-escapes
large-page upper-bound is a bounded functional/DoS-class concern (empty result set), out of scope and not exploitable

author: code-quality-reviewer

findings.description: The test body contains a `for` loop over page values, which testing-principles.md § Assertions explicitly prohibits: 'No `if/else`, `switch`, or loops. Use collection-aware assertions instead.' A loop hides which input caused a failure. Replace with `@ParameterizedTest` and `@ValueSource(strings = {"0", "-1", "-99"})`.

`new Owner()` constructs a production type directly in a new test. testing-principles.md § Factory Methods is explicit: 'A slice adding a test writes it behind one from the start.' Introduce a factory method such as `createAnOwner()` in the test class and call it here instead.

Test name `processFindFormClampsPageBelowOneToFirstPage` identifies the method under test, not the behavior. testing-principles.md § Test Naming requires new tests to follow the BDD school (`the{Subject}Should{Outcome}`). Line 96 is explicit: 'A slice that touches a test renames only that test.' Suggested name: `theOwnerListingPageShouldTreatAnyPageValueBelowOneAsPageOne`.
findings.fix: Rename the method to a behavior-first BDD name, e.g. `theOwnerListingPageShouldTreatAnyPageValueBelowOneAsPageOne`.

findings.description: Variable `tasks` is a semantic mismatch for `Page<Owner>` — it is a stale copy-paste from the adjacent `processFindFormSuccess` test. The name gives a future reader no signal about what the value holds. Rename to `ownersPage` or `ownersResult`.

approved_aspects: Production fix is correct and minimal: `Math.max(page, 1)` placed at method entry before any business logic is the right guard point
Inline comment in OwnerController adds the 'why' without restating the expression mechanically
Boundary values chosen for the test (0, -1, -99) cover the edge and a deep negative — adequate signal
`model().attribute("currentPage", 1)` assertion directly verifies the clamped value reaches the view model

author: test-reviewer

findings.description: Loop in test body. The for-loop over List.of("0","-1","-99") violates testing-principles.md: tests are straight-line code with no if/else, switch, or loops in test bodies. A @ParameterizedTest with @CsvSource is the sanctioned structure for this pattern. The checklist also requires @ParameterizedTest for repetitive test cases.

BDD naming violation. The method name 'processFindFormClampsPageBelowOneToFirstPage' names the production method rather than the behavior. testing-principles.md Test Naming section: the naming school is BDD the{Subject}Should{Outcome}, applies to tests written from 2026-07-31 onward. A name such as 'theOwnerListPageParamBelowOneShouldClampToFirstPage' describes the observable contract instead of the method being called.

Variable 'tasks' is named for the wrong domain. Page<Owner> carries owners, not tasks. Three-tier naming requires the variable to describe its role. The name 'matchingOwners' or 'ownersPage' would be appropriate. The same name appears in the pre-existing sibling test but the new test must comply from the start per the brief.
findings.fix: Rename 'tasks' to 'matchingOwners' in the new test.

findings.description: Direct constructor call 'new Owner()' in the new test. testing-principles.md Test Data Construction: tests never call production constructors directly; a slice adding a test writes construction behind a factory method from the start. An anonymous factory such as createAnOwner() must replace the bare constructor call.
findings.fix: Introduce a private createAnOwner() factory method in the test class (following the pattern of george()) and replace 'new Owner()' with it.

Test genuinely reproduces the bug: page=0 previously reached PageRequest.of(-1,...) which Spring Data rejects with IllegalArgumentException; the fix blocks that path
Assertions are complete: HTTP 200, correct view name, and model attribute currentPage==1 all verified
Input selection of 0, -1, and -99 covers the boundary and two negative distances, showing the rule holds broadly
Mock setup correctly stubs the repository so the clamping logic is isolated from data access
Test passes cleanly with no failures
